audience: Operations analysts resolving payment breaks under a same-day deadline
rationale: Analysts scan hundreds of unmatched transactions per session and act on the ones that will breach cut-off. Errors are expensive and hard to reverse, so the surface must make state and consequence unambiguous and must never suggest that a routine action is more significant than it is.

seriousPlayful.reason: Mistakes move money and are audited, so any levity would undermine confidence in the record.
consequences: No illustration, no celebratory motion, no exclamation in copy
Single restrained accent reserved for the primary action
Motion limited to feedback and continuity with no overshoot

warmClinical.reason: Users are trained analysts working at speed; precision reads as respect for their time where friendliness reads as padding.
consequences: Grotesque letterforms with tight line height in data regions
Domain terminology without contractions outside onboarding

understatedExpressive.reason: The data is the interest. Surface treatment competing with it slows scanning.
consequences: Flat surfaces with at most two elevation levels
Contrast carried by weight and position rather than colour
No gradients outside the status indicator set

denseSpacious.reason: Analysts compare many rows at once; anything that pushes rows below the fold costs a scroll per comparison.
consequences: Dense row heights with rules rather than whitespace for separation
Marketing-page spacing is never applied inside the work surface

establishedNovel.reason: The category is audited and the audience is trained on existing tools, so convention lowers the cost of adoption.
consequences: Conventional table, filter, and form patterns
Novelty confined to the declared budget positions

adopted: High information density with tight row heights
Rules and borders rather than whitespace for separation
Colour reserved almost entirely for status
rejected: Small type below the legibility floor for sustained reading
Touch targets sized for pointer-only use

noveltyBudget.position: Break-age indicator in the transaction table
noveltyBudget.decision: A single inline horizontal bar encoding time remaining to cut-off, replacing a separate deadline column
noveltyBudget.reason: Urgency is the one judgment analysts make on every row, so it should be readable without a second fixation.

noveltyBudget.decision: Numeric-first composition where matched, unmatched, and at-risk totals are the largest type on the page
noveltyBudget.reason: The session begins and ends with these three numbers, so they carry the display role rather than a page title.

person.reason: Records are read by auditors, so statements describe the system rather than address a reader.

register.reason: Settlement terminology is precise and the audience is fluent in it.

density.reason: Labels rather than sentences keep rows scannable.

certainty.reason: Amounts pending settlement must be qualified rather than stated as final.

humour.reason: No moment in this product is a safe place for levity.

nonGoals: A dashboard-first landing surface, because analysts arrive with a specific break to resolve
Illustrated empty states, which would read as padding in an audited workflow
A second accent for secondary actions, which would remove the single primary emphasis
